CREATE TABLE "public"."ApiKey" (
  "allowedOrigins" text[] NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" text NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "keyHash" text NOT NULL,
  "keyPrefix" character varying(16) NOT NULL,
  "lastUsedAt" timestamptz,
  "mode" text DEFAULT 'live' NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "rateLimitPerMin" int4 DEFAULT 60 NOT NULL,

  CONSTRAINT "ApiKey_type_check_9bdbd101" CHECK ("type" IN ('publishable', 'secret'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."AttributionCredit" (

)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Booking" (

)
